text: Evening. I'm stepdad to Kian, he's 5. Not sure if I'm overthinking this, but I noticed some small dark red dots on his tummy and the backs of his legs when I was getting him into pyjamas. I think they're maybe pinprick size, a few bigger ones that look more like little bruises. His mum said try the glass thing so I pressed a tumbler on them and as far as I can tell they don't go away, you can still see them clearly through it. He hasn't had any knocks that I know of. Just wanted to run it past someone.
